{{Quote|Tiperoo, this creature is called. Yes.|Yoda|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
A '''tiperoo''' was a diminutive creature with [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, two green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a prominent lower [[Bone/Legends|jaw]], and a glowing antenna. One such being was present at [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]], a street cafe located in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] while a [[Unidentified young new recruit|precocious Jedi Initiate]] was visiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to create a songbook for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="YCAC" />
